title: Outreach: Engineering a Stronger Community | Highlander Robotics
description: Discover how Team 8033 shares STEM through workshops, camps, mentoring, and community events. Explore our outreach season by season.
body:
STEM is for everyone

Engineering Beyond the Lab

We share what we learn through hands-on workshops, student mentoring, camps, and community partnerships. Explore the people and projects behind each season.

Connect With Our Team
